n, b = map(int, input().split())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))
values = [(-1 if num % 2 == 0 else 1) for num in numbers]

totalSum = 0
differences = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    totalSum += values[i]
    if totalSum == 0:
        diff = abs(numbers[i + 1] - numbers[i])
        differences.append(diff)

differences.sort()

accumulatedCost = 0
maxCount = 0
for diff in differences:
    if accumulatedCost + diff <= b:
        accumulatedCost += diff
        maxCount += 1

print(maxCount)
